notes:
Follow-up release fixing two more rebrand misses identified after v1.0.31 went live, plus an admin-login rescue path for users who can't get past the dashboard's email/password form. No functional changes for the trading engine. This is a normal point release - both v1.0.31 and v1.0.32 share the `com.asasystems.terminal` Tauri identifier, so v1.0.31 users update via the in-app updater the same way every other point release lands. No manual install required. ### Fixes - **Splash screen wordmark.** The Tauri main window flashes a brief React splash (`tray-app/src/App.tsx`) while the Flask sidecar boots. The wordmark there was rendered as styled text spans (`tradespace`), which the v1.0.30/31 grep-based rebrand passes missed because the substring "tradespace" never appears as a literal in the source. Replaced with the canonical ASA path-based wordmark inlined as SVG (mirrors `branding/svg/asa-wordmark-mono-white.svg`), with the middle "S" tinted `#00D4AA` to match the app's existing teal-green accent. The "Starting..." subtitle is preserved; a small uppercase "TERMINAL" label sits between the wordmark and the boot message. - **Login screen wordmark.** Same root cause — `templates/login.html` rendered the legacy wordmark as `

tradespace

` styled by `.logo h1` / `.logo span`, again invisible to a literal-string grep. Swapped to `

ASA Terminal

` so the existing CSS class structure (font, weight, accent colour split, hover/focus transitions) carries over unchanged. Tagline switched from "Signal Copier & Trading Panel" to "Automated Strategy Analytics" — the ASA backronym, which keeps the wordmark and tagline conceptually consistent with the new brand. - **Dashboard sidebar wordmark.** `dashboard.html:33` rendered the persistent left-rail wordmark as `tradespace` — visible on every page of the dashboard. Same span-pattern fix: now `ASA Terminal`, CSS classes unchanged. - **Onboarding wizard heading.** `templates/onboarding.html:58` showed `

TradeSpace Setup

` to users on first run. Now `

ASA Terminal Setup

`. - **Admin operator dashboard heading.** `templates/admin.html:63` showed `

tradespace admin

` at the top of the operator panel. Now `

ASA Terminal admin

`. (Internal-only surface — the operator role gate hides this from regular users — but it still ships in every install.) ### Admin login rescue (`migrate.py::ensure_admin_via_env`) v1.0.32 adds an unconditional rescue path that runs on every startup, separate from the existing migration block. If the operator sets `ASA_ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD` in the environment, this function (a) creates `admin@asaterminal.local` with that password if it doesn't exist, or (b) resets the existing admin's password to that value (and stamps `password_changed_at` so any stale JWT issued before the reset is invalidated). This addresses three scenarios that v1.0.30/31's migration block silently bailed on: 1. Fresh v1.0.30+ installs with no legacy `~/Desktop/TradeSpace/config.json`. The config-driven migration block returns early, so no admin user is ever created and the dashboard's login form returns "Invalid email or password" with no recovery path. 2. Legacy v1.0.x → v1.0.30 migrators whose admin was seeded with the hardcoded `changeme123` password (removed in v1.0.31) and who lost or never recorded that string. The v1.0.31 release notes told them to rotate via the dashboard, but they have to log in first. 3. Anyone who lost the v1.0.31-generated random password (printed once to stdout at first boot, never written to a log). Idempotent — running twice with the same env var is a no-op against the second hash but otherwise safe. Refuses passwords shorter than 8 chars (matches the registration validator). ### Auto-updater note Same shipping pipeline as v1.0.30 / v1.0.31: PyInstaller `server.exe` sidecar -> Tauri NSIS bundle -> manual minisign with `npx tauri signer sign -f - -p ""` from bash (NOT auto-signer in PowerShell pipes — that produces 0-byte sigs) -> SHA256 + UTF-8-no-BOM `latest.json` -> `gh release create` -> uploaded to `cjml34483/TradeSpace-releases`. v1.0.31 -> v1.0.32 auto-updates cleanly because the Tauri identifier hasn't changed.
